mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sale (order_id, user_id, type, reason, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{reason}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, type, reason, status, reply, create_time, update_time FROM after_sale WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN (0, 1) LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.order_id, a.user_id, a.type, a.reason, a.status, a.reply, a.create_time, a.update_time, o.order_no, o.status AS order_status, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS buyer_nickname FROM after_sale a JOIN `order` o ON o.id = a.order_id JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
WHERE a.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.order_id, a.user_id, a.type, a.reason, a.status, a.reply, a.create_time, a.update_time, o.order_no, o.status AS order_status, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS buyer_nickname FROM after_sale a JOIN `order` o ON o.id = a.order_id JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN merchant m ON m.id = p.merchant_id WHERE m.user_id = #{sellerUserId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
